test_rle: test the rle() method on a polars series or lazyframe column to compute run-length encoding with length and value fields
test_rle_id: test the rle_id() method on a polars series or lazyframe column to assign a run identifier to each element based on consecutive groups
test_empty_rle: test that rle() and rle_id() return empty results when called on an empty polars series
create_rle_encoding: create run-length encoding from a polars series using the rle() method to get length and value columns
create_rle_ids: create run-length identifiers from a polars series using the rle_id() method to label consecutive equal elements
